test_name: Search and Filter Users in Admin Dashboard
description: Verifies that the search functionality in the Admin dashboard filters users accurately based on input criteria.
steps: Navigate to the Admin tab using the link with the text 'Admin'.
Locate the search bar labeled 'Search for the users'.
Click the 'Apply' button next to the search bar.
Verify that the user list is filtered to show only users matching 'harish'.
Clear the search criteria and verify the full user list is displayed.
expected_results: User list is successfully filtered based on the search criteria.
Clearing the search criteria restores the full user list.
edge_cases: Search bar fails to accept input due to UI issues.
Search criteria does not filter users correctly.
Apply button is non-functional due to JavaScript errors.
Filtered results do not match the expected criteria.
Clearing search input fails to restore the full user list.
data_requirements: Search bar labeled 'Search for the users'.
dependencies: Apply button linked to the filtering logic.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch filtered user list.
POST request to apply search criteria.
GET request to reset user list.
performance_metrics: Time taken to filter users based on search criteria.
Time taken to restore full user list after clearing search.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure search bar is accessible via keyboard.
Verify ARIA roles and labels for the Apply button.
Check contrast of text in the search bar.
